title: True theorem with an invalid submitted proof
recommended_request: Verify the submitted proof, and distinguish it from an alternative proof of the theorem.
situation: The theorem is true, but commutativity of multiplication does not justify replacing multiplication with addition.

expected.reason: A kernel proof using add_comm establishes the theorem but does not validate the submitted inference.

library_policy.reason: The correct theorem already exists in Mathlib; the invalid inference is never reusable proof content.
